from solution import Service, GatewayTimeout


class Clock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t


class Gateway:
    def __init__(self):
        self.charges = {}
        self.calls = 0
        self.timeouts = 0

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls += 1
        self.charges.setdefault(reference, amount_cents)
        if self.timeouts > 0:
            self.timeouts -= 1
            raise GatewayTimeout()


def make(user="alice", ttl=3600):
    clock, gw = Clock(), Gateway()
    svc = Service(clock, gw, token_ttl=ttl)
    assert svc.register(user, "password1")[0] == 201
    status, body = svc.login(user, "password1")
    assert status == 200
    return svc, clock, gw, body["token"]


def add_user(svc, name):
    assert svc.register(name, "password1")[0] == 201
    return svc.login(name, "password1")[1]["token"]


def test_register_validation():
    svc, _, _, _ = make()
    assert svc.register("ab", "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("Bobby", "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("bob\n", "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("b" * 33, "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("bobby", "short")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("bobby", "password1")[0] == 201
    assert svc.register("bobby", "password1")[0] == 409
    assert svc.login("nobody", "password1")[0] == 401


def test_token_expiry_boundary():
    svc, clock, _, token = make(ttl=100)
    clock.t = 1099.9
    assert svc.export_documents(token)[0] == 200
    clock.t = 1100.0
    assert svc.export_documents(token)[0] == 401


def test_logout():
    svc, _, _, t1 = make()
    t2 = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    assert svc.logout(t1)[0] == 204
    assert svc.export_documents(t1)[0] == 401
    assert svc.logout(t1)[0] == 401
    assert svc.export_documents(t2)[0] == 200


def test_document_validation():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    assert svc.create_document(t, "", "x")[0] == 400
    assert svc.create_document(t, "a" * 201, "x")[0] == 400
    assert svc.create_document(t, "a" * 200, "x" * 100000)[0] == 201
    assert svc.create_document(t, "a", "x" * 100001)[0] == 400
    doc_id = svc.create_document(t, "a", "")[1]["id"]
    assert svc.update_document(t, doc_id, "", "")[0] == 400


def test_ids_not_reused():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    a = svc.create_document(t, "a", "")[1]["id"]
    svc.delete_document(t, a)
    b = svc.create_document(t, "b", "")[1]["id"]
    assert a != b


def test_ownership():
    svc, _, _, ta = make()
    tb = add_user(svc, "bobby")
    d = svc.create_document(ta, "secret", "hidden")[1]["id"]
    assert svc.get_document(tb, d)[0] == 404
    assert svc.update_document(tb, d, "x", "y")[0] == 404
    assert svc.delete_document(tb, d)[0] == 404
    assert svc.get_document(tb, "nope")[0] == 404
    assert svc.search_documents(tb, "secret") == (200, [])
    assert svc.export_documents(tb) == (200, [])
    assert svc.list_documents(tb)[1]["items"] == []
    assert svc.get_document(ta, d)[0] == 200


def test_deleted_never_returned():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    d = svc.create_document(t, "gone", "x")[1]["id"]
    svc.delete_document(t, d)
    assert svc.delete_document(t, d)[0] == 404
    assert svc.update_document(t, d, "a", "b")[0] == 404
    assert svc.export_documents(t)[1] == []
    assert svc.search_documents(t, "gone")[1] == []


def test_pagination():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    ids = [svc.create_document(t, "t%d" % i, "")[1]["id"] for i in range(7)]
    seen, cursor = [], None
    while True:
        status, page = svc.list_documents(t, 3, cursor)
        assert status == 200
        seen += [d["id"] for d in page["items"]]
        cursor = page["next_cursor"]
        if cursor is None:
            break
    assert seen == ids
    # exact multiple: last page has no cursor
    status, page = svc.list_documents(t, 7)
    assert page["next_cursor"] is None


def test_pagination_errors():
    svc, _, _, ta = make()
    tb = add_user(svc, "bobby")
    for i in range(3):
        svc.create_document(ta, "t", "")
    assert svc.list_documents(ta, 0)[0] == 400
    assert svc.list_documents(ta, 101)[0] == 400
    assert svc.list_documents(ta, 1, "bogus")[0] == 400
    cur = svc.list_documents(ta, 1)[1]["next_cursor"]
    assert svc.list_documents(tb, 1, cur)[0] == 400
    assert svc.list_documents(ta, 1, cur)[0] == 200


def test_search():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    svc.create_document(t, "Alpha", "beta")
    svc.create_document(t, "gamma", "ALPHA too")
    assert len(svc.search_documents(t, "alpha")[1]) == 2
    assert svc.search_documents(t, "")[0] == 400


def test_payments_idempotency():
    svc, _, gw, t = make()
    s, p = svc.pay(t, 100, "k")
    assert s == 201
    s2, p2 = svc.pay(t, 100, "k")
    assert s2 == 200 and p2["id"] == p["id"]
    assert svc.pay(t, 200, "k")[0] == 409
    assert len(svc.list_payments(t)[1]) == 1
    assert len(gw.charges) == 1


def test_payment_validation():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    assert svc.pay(t, 0, "k")[0] == 400
    assert svc.pay(t, 1000001, "k")[0] == 400
    assert svc.pay(t, 1.5, "k")[0] == 400
    assert svc.pay(t, True, "k")[0] == 400
    assert svc.pay(t, 1000000, "k")[0] == 201


def test_keys_scoped_to_user():
    svc, _, gw, ta = make()
    tb = add_user(svc, "bobby")
    assert svc.pay(ta, 100, "k")[0] == 201
    assert svc.pay(tb, 500, "k")[0] == 201
    assert len(gw.charges) == 2
    assert len(svc.list_payments(tb)[1]) == 1


def test_timeout_then_retry():
    svc, _, gw, t = make()
    gw.timeouts = 1
    assert svc.pay(t, 100, "k")[0] == 504
    assert svc.list_payments(t)[1] == []
    s, p = svc.pay(t, 100, "k")
    assert s in (200, 201)
    assert len(svc.list_payments(t)[1]) == 1
    assert len(gw.charges) == 1
    assert svc.pay(t, 100, "k")[0] == 200
    assert len(svc.list_payments(t)[1]) == 1


def test_invalid_tokens():
    svc, _, _, _ = make()
    assert svc.pay(None, 1, "k")[0] == 401
    assert svc.list_payments("x")[0] == 401
    assert svc.logout("x")[0] == 401
    assert svc.list_documents([])[0] == 401

import re

import pytest
from hypothesis import given, settings, strategies as st

from solution import Service

try:
    from gateway import GatewayTimeout  # noqa: F401
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    pass


class Clock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t


class Gateway:
    def __init__(self):
        self.charged = {}
        self.calls = []

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        self.charged.setdefault(reference, amount_cents)
        return True


def make(ttl=3600):
    clock = Clock()
    gw = Gateway()
    return Service(clock, gw, token_ttl=ttl), clock, gw


def login_user(svc, name="alice", pw="password1"):
    s, _ = svc.register(name, pw)
    assert s == 201, f"register {name!r} -> {s!r}"
    s, body = svc.login(name, pw)
    assert s == 200, f"login {name!r} -> {s!r}"
    return body["token"]


def mkdoc(svc, tok, title="t", content="c"):
    s, b = svc.create_document(tok, title, content)
    assert s == 201, f"create {title!r} -> {s!r} {b!r}"
    return b["id"]


# ---- M000: update_document with invalid token must be exactly 401 ----

def test_update_document_unknown_token_is_401():
    """update_document returns 401 for a missing or unknown token."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = login_user(svc)
    d = mkdoc(svc, tok)
    for bad in (None, "", "unknown-token"):
        out = svc.update_document(bad, d, "x", "y")
        assert out == (401, None), f"token={bad!r} output={out!r}"


def test_update_document_revoked_and_expired_token_is_401():
    """update_document returns 401 for a revoked token and for an expired token."""
    svc, clock, _ = make(ttl=10)
    tok = login_user(svc)
    tok2 = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    d = mkdoc(svc, tok)
    assert svc.logout(tok)[0] == 204
    out = svc.update_document(tok, d, "x", "y")
    assert out == (401, None), f"revoked token output={out!r}"
    clock.t += 10
    out = svc.update_document(tok2, d, "x", "y")
    assert out == (401, None), f"expired token output={out!r}"


@given(st.text(max_size=20))
@settings(max_examples=30, deadline=None)
def test_property_update_with_bad_token_is_401_and_changes_nothing(bad):
    """update_document with a token that was never issued returns 401 and leaves the document unchanged."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = login_user(svc)
    d = mkdoc(svc, tok, "orig", "body")
    out = svc.update_document(bad, d, "new", "newbody")
    assert out == (401, None), f"token={bad!r} output={out!r}"
    got = svc.get_document(tok, d)
    assert got[0] == 200 and got[1]["title"] == "orig" and got[1]["content"] == "body", \
        f"token={bad!r} get_output={got!r}"


# ---- M001 / M004: update and get must return and store the document ----

def test_update_document_returns_and_stores_new_values():
    """update_document returns 200 with the updated document and later reads show the new title and content."""
    svc, clock, _ = make()
    tok = login_user(svc)
    clock.t = 1234.0
    d = mkdoc(svc, tok, "old", "oldbody")
    clock.t = 2000.0
    out = svc.update_document(tok, d, "new title", "new body")
    exp = {"id": d, "owner": "alice", "title": "new title", "content": "new body", "created_at": 1234.0}
    assert out == (200, exp), f"output={out!r} expected={exp!r}"
    got = svc.get_document(tok, d)
    assert got == (200, exp), f"output={got!r} expected={exp!r}"
    lst = svc.export_documents(tok)
    assert lst == (200, [exp]), f"output={lst!r} expected={[exp]!r}"
    found = svc.search_documents(tok, "NEW BODY")
    assert found == (200, [exp]), f"output={found!r}"
    assert svc.search_documents(tok, "oldbody") == (200, []), "old content still searchable"


@given(st.text(min_size=1, max_size=50), st.text(max_size=200))
@settings(max_examples=40, deadline=None)
def test_property_update_then_get_roundtrip(title, content):
    """After a valid update, get_document returns exactly the new title and content."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = login_user(svc)
    d = mkdoc(svc, tok, "a", "b")
    out = svc.update_document(tok, d, title, content)
    assert out[0] == 200 and out[1]["title"] == title and out[1]["content"] == content, \
        f"input={(title, content)!r} output={out!r}"
    got = svc.get_document(tok, d)
    assert got[0] == 200, f"input={(title, content)!r} output={got!r}"
    assert got[1] == {"id": d, "owner": "alice", "title": title, "content": content,
                      "created_at": 1000.0}, f"input={(title, content)!r} output={got!r}"


def test_get_document_returns_full_document():
    """get_document returns 200 with the document containing id, owner, title, content and created_at."""
    svc, clock, _ = make()
    tok = login_user(svc)
    clock.t = 77.5
    d = mkdoc(svc, tok, "T", "C")
    out = svc.get_document(tok, d)
    exp = {"id": d, "owner": "alice", "title": "T", "content": "C", "created_at": 77.5}
    assert out == (200, exp), f"output={out!r} expected={exp!r}"


@given(st.lists(st.tuples(st.text(min_size=1, max_size=20), st.text(max_size=30)), min_size=1, max_size=6))
@settings(max_examples=30, deadline=None)
def test_property_get_returns_each_created_document(docs):
    """Each created document can be read back by its owner with the stored title and content."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = login_user(svc)
    ids = [mkdoc(svc, tok, t, c) for t, c in docs]
    for d, (t, c) in zip(ids, docs):
        out = svc.get_document(tok, d)
        assert out == (200, {"id": d, "owner": "alice", "title": t, "content": c, "created_at": 1000.0}), \
            f"input={d!r} output={out!r}"


# ---- M002: username validation ----

@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["abc", "a_1", "user_name_01", "a" * 32, "000", "___"])
def test_valid_usernames_register_with_201(name):
    """A username of 3 to 32 characters from [a-z0-9_] registers with 201."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    out = svc.register(name, "password1")
    assert out == (201, None), f"input={name!r} output={out!r}"
    assert svc.login(name, "password1")[0] == 200, f"input={name!r} login failed"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["ab", "", "ABC", "abc!", "a b", "a" * 33, "ab-c", "abc.d"])
def test_invalid_usernames_register_with_400(name):
    """A username outside 3 to 32 characters of [a-z0-9_] is rejected with 400 and creates no user."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    out = svc.register(name, "password1")
    assert out == (400, None), f"input={name!r} output={out!r}"
    assert svc.login(name, "password1")[0] == 401, f"input={name!r} user was created"


@given(st.from_regex(r"[a-z0-9_]{3,32}", fullmatch=True))
@settings(max_examples=50, deadline=None)
def test_property_valid_usernames_accepted(name):
    """Every username of 3 to 32 characters from [a-z0-9_] registers with 201."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    out = svc.register(name, "password1")
    assert out == (201, None), f"input={name!r} output={out!r}"


@given(st.text(alphabet="abcXYZ-. !@", min_size=3, max_size=10).filter(
    lambda s: re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9_]{3,32}", s) is None))
@settings(max_examples=50, deadline=None)
def test_property_invalid_usernames_rejected(name):
    """Every username containing a character outside [a-z0-9_] is rejected with 400."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    out = svc.register(name, "password1")
    assert out == (400, None), f"input={name!r} output={out!r}"


# ---- M003: logout returns exactly 204 ----

def test_logout_returns_204_with_no_body():
    """logout with a valid token returns 204 and no body."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = login_user(svc)
    out = svc.logout(tok)
    assert out == (204, None), f"output={out!r}"


@given(st.integers(min_value=1, max_value=4))
@settings(max_examples=10, deadline=None)
def test_property_logout_of_each_token_returns_204(n):
    """Logging out each of a user's valid tokens returns 204 and then rejects only that token."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    first = login_user(svc)
    toks = [first] + [svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"] for _ in range(n - 1)]
    for i, t in enumerate(toks):
        out = svc.logout(t)
        assert out == (204, None), f"token index={i} output={out!r}"
        assert svc.list_payments(t)[0] == 401, f"token index={i} still valid"
        for other in toks[i + 1:]:
            assert svc.list_payments(other)[0] == 200, f"other token rejected after logout {i}"


# ---- M005: amount validation ----

@pytest.mark.parametrize("amount", [1, 2, 3, 100, 999999, 1000000])
def test_valid_amounts_are_charged_with_201(amount):
    """An integer amount from 1 to 1,000,000 returns 201 with a payment carrying that amount."""
    svc, _, gw = make()
    tok = login_user(svc)
    out = svc.pay(tok, amount, "key-1")
    assert out[0] == 201, f"input={amount!r} output={out!r}"
    assert out[1]["amount_cents"] == amount and out[1]["idempotency_key"] == "key-1", \
        f"input={amount!r} output={out!r}"
    assert len(gw.calls) == 1 and gw.calls[0][1] == amount, f"input={amount!r} calls={gw.calls!r}"
    assert len(svc.list_payments(tok)[1]) == 1, f"input={amount!r} payments recorded wrongly"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("amount", [0, -1, -1000, 1000001, 2000000])
def test_invalid_amounts_rejected_with_400(amount):
    """An amount below 1 or above 1,000,000 returns 400, records nothing and charges nothing."""
    svc, _, gw = make()
    tok = login_user(svc)
    out = svc.pay(tok, amount, "key-1")
    assert out == (400, None), f"input={amount!r} output={out!r}"
    assert gw.calls == [], f"input={amount!r} gateway calls={gw.calls!r}"
    assert svc.list_payments(tok) == (200, []), f"input={amount!r} payment recorded"


@given(st.integers(min_value=1, max_value=1000000))
@settings(max_examples=60, deadline=None)
def test_property_amounts_in_range_accepted(amount):
    """Every integer amount from 1 to 1,000,000 is accepted with 201."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = login_user(svc)
    out = svc.pay(tok, amount, "k")
    assert out[0] == 201 and out[1]["amount_cents"] == amount, f"input={amount!r} output={out!r}"


@given(st.one_of(st.integers(max_value=0), st.integers(min_value=1000001)))
@settings(max_examples=60, deadline=None)
def test_property_amounts_out_of_range_rejected(amount):
    """Every integer amount below 1 or above 1,000,000 is rejected with 400 and not charged."""
    svc, _, gw = make()
    tok = login_user(svc)
    out = svc.pay(tok, amount, "k")
    assert out == (400, None), f"input={amount!r} output={out!r}"
    assert gw.calls == [], f"input={amount!r} calls={gw.calls!r}"

from hypothesis import given, settings, strategies as st

from solution import Service


class _Clock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = float(t)

    def now(self):
        return self.t


class _Gateway:
    def __init__(self):
        self.charges = {}

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.charges.setdefault(reference, amount_cents)
        return {"reference": reference, "amount_cents": amount_cents}


def _make(ttl=3600):
    clock = _Clock()
    gw = _Gateway()
    return Service(clock, gw, token_ttl=ttl), clock, gw


def _login(svc, name="alice", password="password1"):
    s, b = svc.register(name, password)
    assert s == 201, f"register input={name!r} output={(s, b)!r}"
    s, b = svc.login(name, password)
    assert s == 200, f"login input={name!r} output={(s, b)!r}"
    return b["token"]


_TEXT = st.text(alphabet="abcdefXYZ 0123456789", min_size=0, max_size=40)
_TITLE = st.text(alphabet="abcdefXYZ 0123456789", min_size=1, max_size=40)


# ---- M000: create_document must answer 401 for bad tokens ----

def test_create_document_unknown_token_is_401():
    """Every token-taking method, including create_document, returns 401 for an unknown token."""
    svc, _, _ = _make()
    for tok in ("no-such-token", "", None):
        out = svc.create_document(tok, "title", "content")
        assert out[0] == 401, f"input={tok!r} output={out!r}"


def test_create_document_expired_token_is_401():
    """create_document returns 401 for a token whose TTL has elapsed."""
    svc, clock, _ = _make(ttl=100)
    tok = _login(svc)
    clock.t += 100
    out = svc.create_document(tok, "title", "content")
    assert out[0] == 401, f"input={tok!r} output={out!r}"


def test_create_document_revoked_token_is_401():
    """create_document returns 401 for a revoked token."""
    svc, _, _ = _make()
    tok = _login(svc)
    assert svc.logout(tok)[0] == 204
    out = svc.create_document(tok, "title", "content")
    assert out[0] == 401, f"input={tok!r} output={out!r}"


@settings(max_examples=30, deadline=None)
@given(tok=st.text(alphabet="abcdef0123456789-", min_size=0, max_size=30))
def test_create_document_never_accepts_unissued_token(tok):
    """create_document returns 401 for any token that was never issued."""
    svc, _, _ = _make()
    out = svc.create_document(tok, "title", "content")

import pytest
from hypothesis import given, settings, strategies as st

from solution import Service


class ManualClock:
    def __init__(self, now=123.0):
        self.value = float(now)

    def now(self):
        return self.value

    def advance(self, seconds):
        self.value += seconds


class RecordingGateway:
    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))


def logged_in_service(username="alice_1", password="password123"):
    clock = ManualClock()
    gateway = RecordingGateway()
    service = Service(clock, gateway)
    out = service.register(username, password)
    assert out == (201, None), f"input={(username, password)!r} output={out!r}"
    out = service.login(username, password)
    assert out[0] == 200 and isinstance(out[1], dict) and isinstance(out[1].get("token"), str), (
        f"input={(username, password)!r} output={out!r}"
    )
    return service, clock, gateway, out[1]["token"], username


@given(
    username=st.text(
        alphabet=list("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_"),
        min_size=3,
        max_size=32,
    ),
    password=st.text(
        alphabet=list("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_!@#"),
        min_size=8,
        max_size=24,
    ),
)
@settings(max_examples=25)
def test_register_accepts_valid_usernames_and_rejects_duplicate(username, password):
    """A valid username and password must register with 201, and registering the same username again must return 409."""
    service = Service(ManualClock(), RecordingGateway())
    out1 = service.register(username, password)
    assert out1 == (201, None), f"input={(username, password)!r} output={out1!r}"
    out2 = service.register(username, password)
    assert out2 == (409, None), f"input={(username, password)!r} output={out2!r}"

    service, _clock, _gateway, token, _username = logged_in_service()

    assert out == (204, None), f"input={token!r} output={out!r}"


def test_get_document_returns_the_owned_document_dict():
    """Getting an existing owned document must return 200 with that document."""
    service, clock, _gateway, token, username = logged_in_service()
    create_input = (token, "Original title", "Original content")
    created = service.create_document(*create_input)
    assert created[0] == 201 and isinstance(created[1], dict) and isinstance(created[1].get("id"), str), (
        f"input={create_input!r} output={created!r}"
    )
    doc_id = created[1]["id"]

    get_input = (token, doc_id)
    try:
        out = service.get_document(*get_input)
    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - used to expose incorrect implementations
        pytest.fail(f"input={get_input!r} output={exc!r}")

    expected = {
        "id": doc_id,
        "owner": username,
        "title": "Original title",
        "content": "Original content",
        "created_at": clock.value,

    assert out == (200, expected), f"input={get_input!r} output={out!r}"
